el(x){if(!x)return'—';if(x.status&&x.status!=='OPERATING')return x.status==='DOWN'?'Down':x.status==='REFURBISHMENT'?'Refurb':'Closed';return x.standby==null?'No wait posted':`${x.standby} min`}
+function liveWalkMinutes(a,b){if(!a||!b||!a.location||!b.location)return null;const la=a.location,lb=b.location;if(la.latitude==null||la.longitude==null||lb.latitude==null||lb.longitude==null)return null;const R=6371000,toR=x=>x*Math.PI/180,dlat=toR(lb.latitude-la.latitude),dlon=toR(lb.longitude-la.longitude),q=Math.sin(dlat/2)**2+Math.cos(toR(la.latitude))*Math.cos(toR(lb.latitude))*Math.sin(dlon/2)**2,m=2*R*Math.asin(Math.sqrt(q));return Math.max(2,Math.round((m*1.35)/75))}
+function lastCompletedAttraction(dayIndex,park){let found=null;DAYS[dayIndex].blocks.forEach(b=>(b.ids||[]).forEach(id=>{const x=BY_ID[id];if(x&&x.park===park&&status(id,dayIndex)==='done')found=x}));return found}
+function currentLocationLive(park){const key='dw27_here_'+park,stored=localStorage.getItem(key);if(stored&&BY_ID[stored])return liveByName(park,BY_ID[stored].name);const x=lastCompletedAttraction(currentDay,park);return x?liveByName(park,x.name):null}
+function setLiveHere(id){if(!id)return;const x=BY_ID[id];if(!x)return;localStorage.setItem('dw27_here_'+x.park,id);renderToday()}
+function plannedIdsForPark(d,park){const out=[];d.blocks.forEach((b,bi)=>(b.ids||[]).forEach((id,ii)=>{const x=BY_ID[id];if(x&&x.park===park&&!out.some(o=>o.id===id))out.push({id,bi,ii,x})}));return out}
+function timeToMinutes(t){if(!t)return null;const [h,m]=t.split(':').map(Number);return Number.isFinite(h)&&Number.isFinite(m)?h*60+m:null}
+function nowMinutes(){const d=new Date(),parts=new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US',{hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit',hour12:false,timeZone:'America/New_York'}).formatToParts(d),h=Number(parts.find(x=>x.type==='hour')?.value),m=Number(parts.find(x=>x.type==='minute')?.value);return h*60+m}
+function nextAnchorForDay(d){
+ const now=isSelectedDayToday()?nowMinutes():0,arr=[];d.blocks.forEach((b,bi)=>{if(b.reservation){const t=getReservationTime(b);if(t)arr.push({t,name:'Appointment',meta:b.area||'',bi})}[['meal',b.meal],['meal2',b.meal2]].forEach(([slot,mid])=>{if(mid){const t=getMealTime(b,slot);if(t)arr.push({t,name:MEALS[mid]?.name||'Meal',meta:b.area||'',bi})}});(b.ids||[]).forEach(id=>{const x=BY_ID[id],t=x?.kind==='show'?getChosenShowTime(b,id):'';if(t)arr.push({t,name:x.name,meta:'Show',bi})})});
+ plannedIdsForPark(d,liveDayPark).forEach(o=>{const p=llPlan(o.id);if(p.start&&p.state!=='redeemed')arr.push({t:p.start,name:o.x.name,meta:'Lightning Lane',bi:o.bi})});
+ arr.sort((a,b)=>timeToMinutes(a.t)-timeToMinutes(b.t));return arr.find(a=>timeToMinutes(a.t)>=now)||arr[0]||null;

+function liveRecommendations(d,park){
+ const here=currentLocationLive(park),pool=liveAllCandidates(d,park),anchor=nextAnchorForDay(d),minsToAnchor=anchor&&isSelectedDayToday()?timeToMinutes(anchor.t)-nowMinutes():null;
+ const candidates=[];pool.forEach((o,order)=>{if(status(o.id,currentDay)==='done'||o.x.kind==='show')return;const l=liveByName(park,o.x.name);if(l&&l.status&&l.status!=='OPERATING')return;if(liveRouteMode==='nearby'&&!l)return;const walk=liveWalkMinutes(here,l),wait=l?.standby??35;let score=wait+(walk??10)*1.8+order*1.5+(o.planned?-7:5);const lp=llPlan(o.id);if(lp.start&&lp.state==='booked')score-=12;if(liveFocusArea&&normalizeAreaForPark(o.x.area,park)===normalizeAreaForPark(liveFocusArea,park))score-=12;if(minsToAnchor!=null&&minsToAnchor>0&&(walk??8)+wait+20>minsToAnchor)score+=100;candidates.push({...o,live:l,walk,score})});
+ candidates.sort((a,b)=>a.score-b.score);return candidates.slice(0,4);

+function renderLLToday(d,park){const rows=plannedIdsForPark(d,park).map(o=>({o,p:llPlan(o.id)})).filter(z=>Object.keys(z.p).length&&z.p.state!=='redeemed');if(!rows.length)return'<div class="liveEmpty">No Lightning Lane targets or bookings saved for this park.</div>';return rows.map(({o,p})=>`<div class="llRow"><div class="anchorTime">${p.start?escAttr(from24Time(p.start)):'Target'}</div><div class="anchorMain"><div class="anchorName">${escAttr(o.x.name)}</div><div class="anchorMeta">${escAttr((llEligibility(o.x)||{}).label||'Lightning Lane')}${p.end?' · until '+escAttr(from24Time(p.end)):''} · ${escAttr(p.state||'planned')}</div></div>${canEditPlanner()?`<button class="tinyAction" onclick="openQuickSheet('attraction',${o.bi},'${o.id}')">Edit</button>`:''}</div>`).join('')}
+function renderTodayUpcoming(d,park){const rows=[];d.blocks.forEach((b,bi)=>{if(blockPark(d,b)!==park)return;const t=blockDisplayTime(b);const names=(b.ids||[]).map(id=>BY_ID[id]?.name).filter(Boolean).slice(0,3);if(b.meal)names.push(MEALS[b.meal]?.name||'Meal');if(b.reservation)names.push('Appointment');if(names.length)rows.push({t,area:b.area||'',names,bi})});return rows.slice(0,7).map(r=>`<div class="upcomingRow"><div class="anchorTime">${escAttr(r.t)}</div><div class="anchorMain"><div class="anchorName">${escAttr(r.area)}</div><div class="anchorMeta">${escAttr(r.names.join(' · '))}</div></div><button class="tinyAction" onclick="currentDay=${currentDay};switchScreen('itinerary');renderAll()">Plan</button></div>`).join('')||'<div class="liveEmpty">No planned blocks for this park.</div>'}
